summary: Frontend smoke + interaction test of 4 new UIs (PPC-3, CS-1, AW-2, PSW-1) as caregiver cathy@example.com. All critical data-testids resolve; end-to-end flows (PPC-3 quality detail + survey POST, PPC-3 provider comparison, CS-1 6-step self-assessment with burnout warm hand-off, AW-2 chat with scope guardrail and hallucination-safe fallback, PSW-1 create switch + decision walkthrough submit) all succeed against live backend. Backend responses observed: 200 for POST /api/ppc3/survey-responses, /api/ppc3/provider-comparison, /api/cs1/assessments, /api/aw2/conversations, /api/aw2/conversations/{id}/messages, /api/psw1/participants/{pid}/switches, /api/psw1/switches/{sid}/decision-walkthrough.

ui_bugs.issue: When URL param pid is literally 'None'/undefined, page throws AxiosError 404 rendered as a fullscreen 'Uncaught runtime errors' React dev overlay instead of graceful empty/error state. Not user-reachable in normal flow, but any bad deep-link crashes the tool.

Missing data-testids: 'psw1-cross-tool-context', 'psw1-context-complaints', 'psw1-context-cases'. The information is rendered on screen ('Unresolved complaints ... 0', 'Open LOOP-1 cases 106') but the container/count elements do not expose the spec'd data-testid attributes.

Missing data-testid 'psw1-final-proceed_with_switch' on step 5. The walkthrough still submits successfully via 'psw1-walkthrough-submit' and the final decision was recorded correctly ('Final decision: proceed with switch'), but the spec'd final-choice radio testid is not present in the DOM.

Rating categories in DOM are care_quality, communication, billing_accuracy, worker_reliability (not the 'reliability' / 'value_for_money' from the review request). Spec wording appears to be an example — flagging as informational to confirm intended taxonomy.

action_items: PSW-1: add data-testid attributes for 'psw1-cross-tool-context' (wrapper), 'psw1-context-complaints' (complaints count), 'psw1-context-cases' (LOOP-1 cases count) on SwitchDecisionWalkthrough page.
PSW-1: add 'psw1-final-proceed_with_switch' (and sibling final-decision options) data-testids on the final decision step so tests can target the specific choice rather than the generic submit.
PSW-1: add a graceful fallback for participants list route when pid param is missing/invalid — currently produces a runtime error overlay from the axios 404.
critical_code_review_comments: PSW-1 walkthrough returns 404 initial GET for /api/psw1/switches/{sid}/decision-walkthrough before any walkthrough exists — page handles it fine, but a 404 in normal happy-path adds console noise. Consider using 200 with empty payload or a HEAD probe.
Confirm intended PPC-3 rating dimensions (billing_accuracy, worker_reliability) vs. review-request wording (reliability, value_for_money) — pick one set consistently.

success_rate.frontend: PPC-3 100% (survey+compare), CS-1 100% (6-step + burnout warm hand-off), AW-2 100% (settings+scope+fallback), PSW-1 ~85% (flow completes; 4 data-testids missing)

Wayly-token key is 'kindred_token', not 'wayly_token'. Active pid is in localStorage 'wayly_active_participant_id'. Missing testids listed in action_items are the only functional gaps.
